children: BCB Bancorp announced pricing of an 11,000,000-share common stock offering for gross proceeds of $85,250,000.
Underwritten public offering of 11,000,000 common shares priced to raise $85,250,000 in gross proceeds.
Offering expected to close Sept 18, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
Underwriter granted 30-day option to buy additional shares at the public offering price.
Piper Sandler & Co. is sole book-running manager for the transaction.
Net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, liquidity, working capital, loan disposition support, debt reduction and maintaining capital ratios.
